% Checks a case the use of a .bbl beside the document must not break:
% every .bib that \bibliography names is there: one by name, one by a
% ../ path with its .bib extension, one by a path into a subdirectory,
% and one that kpathsea finds in the TeX distribution. bibtex runs, as
% latexmk runs it, and the stale .bbl beside is not read.
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
Citations~\cite{groups,lattices,sub,article-full}.
\bibliographystyle{plain}
\bibliography{test-bibindex,../fixtures/test-bibpath.bib,test-bblnobib-sub/test-bblnobib-sub,xampl}
\end{document}
